content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The existing payment platforms often restrict access in regions like Kenya, Nigeria, and Pakistan, leaving creators without options. COREMERCH addresses this gap by providing a sovereign digital commerce stack that removes reliance on third-party platforms. By using blockchain for payments, you can accept cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a minimal fee. This infrastructure empowers you to take control of your sales process, ensuring that you are not vulnerable to sudden payment system failures or restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, gather the necessary tools and resources. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for processing cryptocurrency transactions, and a cloud storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Ensure you have your digital products ready, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates. Familiarize yourself with the integration process for each tool, as this will streamline your deployment and help you launch your store effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for a smooth customer experience. Start by configuring NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a global audience. Next, set up your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure instant access to your digital products upon payment confirmation. This pipeline will enable you to automate the delivery process, so customers receive their purchases immediately, thus improving satisfaction and driving repeat sales.
Empower your e-commerce with sovereign infrastructure that you own.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Launch your online store and promote it to your audience using social media and email marketing. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything operates smoothly. Test the purchasing process from a customer’s perspective to identify any potential issues. With NOWPayments, you will receive notifications for each completed transaction. This real-time feedback is vital to your operations, enabling you to address any hiccups quickly and efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your initial transactions, it’s time to focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed for efficient scaling. Consider expanding your product offerings or marketing to new demographics. Analyze your sales data to identify trends and adapt your strategies accordingly. The infrastructure allows you to scale without the burdens of platform dependencies, enabling you to grow your business on your terms.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no KYC requirements.

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
